cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
cards.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. First day in accounts, and I've reconciled this invoice. I put it in the right drawer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's filing. Reconciliation means matching it to our records.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Filed, then. I'll reconcile it against this quote.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's an estimate. You need the purchase order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Estimate filed; purchase order requested. I'm getting fluent in accounts already.
